parameters.content:
## 1 · Intake & validation
POST a ticket to the webhook below. The "Validate & Normalize" Code node
requires `name`, `email` (regex-checked) and `message`, then mints a ticket
like `TKT-20261019-152301-a1b2`. Invalid tickets are rejected with HTTP 400.

## 2 · Triage & knowledge base
"Classify" is a RULES-BASED keyword scorer — no LLM here. This is the
documented upgrade slot: swap this node for an n8n AI Agent / OpenAI node
in production for smarter classification. "KB lookup" scores 8 embedded
help articles against the ticket text (hit threshold: 2 keyword matches).

## 3 · Routing
Auto-resolvable = KB article matched AND priority is not "high".
Everything else escalates to a human. Low-risk tickets get an instant
answer; urgent or unknown tickets page the right queue.

## 4 · Auto-reply branch (left)
Composes a personalised email from the KB article, POSTs it to the
outbound endpoint ($env.OUTBOUND_EMAIL_URL — point this at Gmail/SMTP in
production), saves the ticket record, and replies 200 to the caller.

## 5 · Escalation branch (right)
Composes a Slack alert with ticket id, category, priority, SLA deadline and
suggested queue, POSTs it to $env.SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL (a real Slack incoming
webhook in production), saves the ticket record, and replies 200.

const input = $input.first().json;
const text = ' ' + input.ticket.text + ' ';
const hit = (kw) => text.includes(kw.toLowerCase());

const KB = [
  { id: 'kb-password-reset', title: 'How to reset your password',
    keywords: ['password', 'reset', 'forgot', 'sign in', 'log in'],
    body: 'Click "Forgot password" on the sign-in page and enter your account email. You will receive a reset link that is valid for 60 minutes. If you do not see it, check your spam folder, then request a new link — each new request invalidates the previous one.',
    link: 'https://support.example.com/articles/password-reset' },
  { id: 'kb-refund-policy', title: 'Refund policy (30 days)',
    keywords: ['refund', 'cancel', 'cancellation', 'money back', '30-day'],
    body: 'We offer a 30-day money-back guarantee on all paid plans. Cancel from Settings → Billing and the refund is issued automatically to your original payment method within 5–10 business days. After 30 days, cancellations stop future billing but are not refunded.',
    link: 'https://support.example.com/articles/refund-policy' },
  { id: 'kb-double-charge', title: 'Why you might see a double charge',
    keywords: ['double', 'charged twice', 'duplicate charge', 'billing'],
    body: 'Most "double charges" are a temporary authorization hold: your bank shows the pending hold plus the settled charge, and the hold drops off in 1–5 business days. If both charges are settled (not pending) after 5 days, reply here and our billing team will reverse the duplicate immediately.',
    link: 'https://support.example.com/articles/double-charge' },
  { id: 'kb-upgrade-plan', title: 'Upgrading or changing your plan',
    keywords: ['upgrade', 'plan', 'pricing', 'subscription', 'trial'],
    body: 'You can upgrade at any time from Settings → Billing → Change plan. The new plan applies immediately and we prorate the difference, so you only pay for what you use. Downgrades take effect at the end of the current billing cycle.',
    link: 'https://support.example.com/articles/upgrade-plan' },
  { id: 'kb-api-errors', title: 'Fixing API 401 and rate-limit errors',
    keywords: ['api', '401', 'rate limit', 'token', 'integration'],
    body: 'A 401 means your API token is missing, expired, or revoked — generate a fresh token in Settings → API keys. A 429 means you hit the rate limit (100 requests/minute); back off exponentially and retry. If 401s persist with a fresh token, check you are sending "Authorization: Bearer <token>".',
    link: 'https://support.example.com/articles/api-errors' },
  { id: 'kb-invite-team', title: 'Inviting team members to your workspace',
    keywords: ['invite', 'teammate', 'member', 'workspace', 'collaborator'],
    body: 'Go to Settings → Team → Invite members and enter their email addresses. Choose Admin for full access or Member for day-to-day use. Invites expire after 7 days — you can resend them from the same page. Guests are free on all paid plans.',
    link: 'https://support.example.com/articles/invite-team' },
  { id: 'kb-export-data', title: 'Exporting your data',
    keywords: ['export', 'download', 'data', 'csv', 'backup'],
    body: 'Export everything from Settings → Data → Export. You can download a CSV of records or a full JSON backup including attachments. Large exports are prepared in the background and emailed to you as a download link within an hour.',
    link: 'https://support.example.com/articles/export-data' },
  { id: 'kb-human-support', title: 'Reaching a human support agent',
    keywords: ['human support', 'talk to someone', 'phone number', 'call us', 'live agent'],
    body: 'To reach a human: reply to any support email and it reopens your ticket, or call us at +1-555-0100 (Mon–Fri, 9am–6pm EAT). Median first response from a human agent is under 2 hours on business days.',
    link: 'https://support.example.com/articles/contact-support' },
];

let bestArticle = null, bestScore = 0;
for (const a of KB) {
  const score = a.keywords.filter(hit).length;
  if (score > bestScore) { bestScore = score; bestArticle = a; }
}
const kbHit = bestScore >= 2;

return [{ json: {
  ...input,
  kb: { kbHit, score: bestScore, article: kbHit ? bestArticle : null },
}}];
